name: Naruse Nono
source: Cheerful girl who moved from a very far place. Loves making joke and has friendly attitude. She wants to becomes a pâtissière, and is now working as a waitress in a cafe run by a famous former pâtissier.
translation: Cheerful girl who moved from a very far place. Loves making joke and has friendly attitude. She wants to becomes a pâtissière, and is now working as a waitress in a cafe run by a famous former pâtissier.
